name: ONE SHOT PLUGIN (CLAUDE CODE STUDIO)
description: Agentic one-shot code generation for existing codebases. Claude conducts a 7-stage pipeline of deterministic scanners (codebase graph, domain extractor, verifier, auto-patcher, wirer) and specialist agents (architect, implementer, test-author, reviewer, wirer, critic) to take a natural-language feature request and ship verified, FK-aware, cost-gated code. Multi-entity, relationship-aware, with a templated zero-token fallback (--templated) for CI / free use. Supports FastAPI, Django, Spring, Go, Node, NestJS.
